statement: Whether the gap survives at a coarse fit depends on the task: on apple dense networks at MSE 0.0065 already score like Picbreeder on M3a and M4a; on butterfly they stay near the fully trained network.
scope: 128x128 image regression on the three Picbreeder CPPNs, 50k iterations, Adam with unit-norm gradients, fit = MSE < 0.01. Perturbations act on existing edges only; matched window of mean |dRGB| in [0.02, 0.10]. G0e against PB and G0. Apple M1 and M1x are not covered: they were in the middle band.
flip_boundary: Unknown; only two tasks and one fit level were measured.
prediction: Post-hoc description of results already seen in C-006, not a prediction. It is kept as a regression lock, and new G0e seeds can still break it.

statement: Fixing the copy edges at 1 and training only NEAT links makes butterfly fit reliably.
scope: 128x128 image regression on the three Picbreeder CPPNs, 50k iterations, Adam with unit-norm gradients, fit = MSE < 0.01. Perturbations act on existing edges only; matched window of mean |dRGB| in [0.02, 0.10]. Batch b6: butterfly seeds 3-8 in each group, fixed in advance; no seeds will be added after seeing results. Only b6 runs count as the test group. A G4 seed whose dense parent misses the fit threshold is not pruned.
flip_boundary: Skull already failed this setup 3 of 3, so success here would be specific to butterfly.
prediction: Hypothesis proposed from outside this analysis: at least 4 of 6 G1a seeds reach MSE < 0.01. The analyst expects this to fail, given C-001.

statement: On butterfly at a similar fit level, Picbreeder wiring with SGD-found weights is closer to Picbreeder than to a dense network, on symmetry metrics.
scope: 128x128 image regression on the three Picbreeder CPPNs, 50k iterations, Adam with unit-norm gradients, fit = MSE < 0.01. Perturbations act on existing edges only; matched window of mean |dRGB| in [0.02, 0.10]. Batch b6: butterfly seeds 3-8 in each group, fixed in advance; no seeds will be added after seeing results. Only b6 runs count as the test group. A G4 seed whose dense parent misses the fit threshold is not pruned. Reference is G0e, a dense network stopped at MSE <= 0.0065, not the fully trained G0, so that r compares networks at a similar fit level.
flip_boundary: The wiring forces the parity of 59% of maps, so M1 and M3a are partly fixed by construction; M1x is the part the wiring leaves free.
prediction: r = (G1b - PB) / (G0e - PB) is at most 0.3 for M1, M1x, M3a and M4a. r >= 0.7 falsifies. Between them is MIXED. This reverses the C-002 prediction, based on one fitted butterfly seed.

statement: On butterfly at a similar fit level, sparsity alone does not make a network Picbreeder-like: pruned networks stay closer to a dense network.
scope: 128x128 image regression on the three Picbreeder CPPNs, 50k iterations, Adam with unit-norm gradients, fit = MSE < 0.01. Perturbations act on existing edges only; matched window of mean |dRGB| in [0.02, 0.10]. Batch b6: butterfly seeds 3-8 in each group, fixed in advance; no seeds will be added after seeing results. Only b6 runs count as the test group. A G4 seed whose dense parent misses the fit threshold is not pruned. Reference is G0e, a dense network stopped at MSE <= 0.0065, not the fully trained G0, so that r compares networks at a similar fit level. G4 as in C-005, pruned from b6 dense networks.
flip_boundary: Results may differ on tasks where coarse fits are already symmetric, as apple is.
prediction: r = (G4 - PB) / (G0e - PB) is at least 0.7 for M1, M1x, M3a and M4a. r <= 0.3 falsifies. Between them is MIXED.
